**h01:** `s3presign.Runner` — every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`) — wired into startup at `server.Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:153`), specifically lines 162–171 where `s3presign.NewRunner` is created, `RunOnce` is called immediately, then `Run` is launched in a goroutine.

**h02:** Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`. Async delivery via `webhook.PostAsync` enqueues into `asyncPostQueue` (line 39), consumed by 4 goroutines launched in `init()` (line 42). Protection mechanism: SSRF protection via `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`) which resolves DNS and checks against reserved IP CIDRs (`isReservedIP`), plus `webhook.ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62`) which validates at webhook-creation time. Reserved CIDRs defined at `internal/webhook/validate.go:14–23`.

**h03:** Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo` struct at `internal/idp/idp.go`). Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (implements OAuth2 protocol via `IdentityProvider` struct at `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`).

Same pattern in `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go` and `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go`. No foreign-key cascade rules handle this.

**r01:** False premise. There is no Redis connection or Redis-based cache layer in this codebase. The cache is an in-process Go implementation (`store/cache/cache.go`) using sync maps and goroutine-based expiration — no external cache service is involved.

**r02:** False premise. There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware in this codebase. No rate-limit code exists anywhere in the server (confirmed by search across all Go files).

**r03:** False premise. There is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. While a `scheduler` package exists under `internal/scheduler/`, it has zero production callers — it is unused library code. The only background runner is the S3 presign runner (`server/runner/s3presign/`) which runs every 12 hours.

**r04:** False premise. There is no message broker (neither NATS nor RabbitMQ). Webhook delivery is synchronous via HTTP POST (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`), dispatched asynchronously through an in-process Go channel (`asyncPostQueue`, line 39) consumed by 4 goroutines — no external queue or broker is involved.

**r05:** False premise. There is no GraphQL schema or GraphQL API. The public API is gRPC with a gRPC-Gateway HTTP/JSON REST proxy, defined via Protocol Buffers in `proto/api/v1/` and generated code in `proto/gen/api/v1/`. An OpenAPI spec is also generated (`proto/gen/openapi.yaml`).
